blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State-run Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) has granted a P100-million loan to an agricultural cooperative to fund the working capital requirements of small-scale farmers in Cagayan Valley. In a statement, DBP said it extended the loan to the Unified Tillers Agriculture Cooperative (UTAC), a Department of Agriculture (DA) merchant partner since 2022 […]...
